name: Geoloods
description: Resolves named places (cities, towns, villages, parks, landmarks) to coordinates plus country, timezone and population data over a JSON HTTP API. Not street-level addresses or venue search.

skills.name: Place search
skills.description: Resolve a named place (city, town, village, park or landmark) to gazetteer records by query string, with an optional language parameter.

skills.name: Reverse geocode
skills.description: Find the named place for a latitude/longitude pair, with a default filter that prefers settlement and admin labels over venues.

skills.name: Nearby places
skills.description: List named places within a radius of given coordinates, sorted by distance, including gazetteer venues such as hotels.

skills.name: Bounding box query
skills.description: Return named places inside a latitude/longitude rectangle of up to 10 degrees on a side.

skills.name: Country lookup
skills.description: List countries with their ISO codes and accompanying metadata.
